Car Presentation – United States Grand Prix 
McLaren Mastercard F1 Team 
 
  Updated component Primary reason for update Geometric differences compared to previous version  Brief description on how the update works (min 20, max 100 words) 
1 Front Corner Performance - Flow Conditioning Revised Front Corner and Furniture The front corner scoop and furniture have been revised in conjunction with the front suspension fairings aiming at improved flow conditioning. 
2 Rear Corner Performance - Flow Conditioning Updated Rear Corner Furniture The rear corner furniture has been revised to achieve an improvement in flow conditioning as well as increased local load. 
3 Diffuser Performance - Flow Conditioning New diffuser geometry The diffuser geometry has been modified aiming at an improvement of flow conditioning and local load across the speed range.

Oracle Red Bull Racing

Brief description on how the update works 
(min 20, max 100 words)  
1 Front Wing Performance - Local Load Additional vane on the endplate foot plate 
Taking the recently introduced front wing 
geometry, an option to operate with the tyre 
temperature turning vane has been added for 
evaluation, offering a tyre surface temperature 
measurement as well as more local load with 
similar flow stability. 
2 Front Corner Reliability Elastomeric gaitor profile revision  
The periphery of the gaitor has been revised to 
reduce the likelihood of tearing the elastomeric 
material during running by reducing the strain in 
the regions of highest deflection when steering lock 
is applied.

Updated board brace layout, redesigned front floor

Key development features have focused on 
increasing floor downforce (on both front and rear 
parts) whilst also increasing energy levels  and flow 
stability sent towards the back of the car 
2 Floor Board 
3 Sidepod Inlet / Coke Sidepod inlet additional lower volume, reshaped undercut and coke line volumes

Benefitting from  improved onset flow quality, the

Car Presentation – United States Grand Prix 
Visa Cash App Racing Bulls 
 
  Updated component Primary reason for update Geometric differences compared to previous version  Brief description on how the update works (min 20, max 100 words) 
1 Front Wing Performance - Flow Conditioning New front wing endplate  
The front wing endplate plays an important role in 
managing the flow around the front tyres. These 
updates further improve the management of the 
flow field downstream.  
2 Rear Wing Performance - Local Load New flap elements The camber and chord of the rear wing flap elements has been modified to clean up the local flow and allow the wing to generate more load. 
3 Floor Body Performance - Local Load Multiple changes including leading edge devices, board and floor edge 
A combination of developments across a number of 
key floor components which improves the overall 
flow management around the floor. This translates 
into an efficient downforce increase. 
4 Coke/Engine Cover Performance - Flow Conditioning Reprofiled shoulder and undercut 
Working in combination with the updates made to 
the floor, the changes to the engine cover help 
manage the flow as it passes around the side of the 
car and towards the rear.

1 Front Corner Performance - Flow conditioning  New front brake duct 
The revised front brake duct provides updated 
cooling characteristics together with associated 
aerodynamic performance, complementing the 
latest development steps introduced. 
2 Front Floor Performance - Flow conditioning  New Floor Board 
The updated floorboard geometry is intended to 
improve local flow conditioning and support the 
overall aerodynamic performance of the floor 
assembly. 
3 Mirror stay Performance - Flow conditioning  New Mirror Stay 
The updated mirror stay geometry complements the 
revised front corner configuration and supports the 
overall aerodynamic performance of the car package 
introduced lately.

Revised geometry improves flow conditioning to
